about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Carlos A. Gimenez

pages.title: Carlos Gimenez for Congress | Common Sense Leadership - Common Sense Leadership for South Florida
pages.text:
" * " indicates required fields
Common Sense Leadership
for South Florida
Born in Cuba in 1954, Gimenez immigrated to the United States with his family following the Cuban Revolution in 1960. His family settled in Miami’s Little Havana neighborhood and Gimenez has been a Miami-Dade resident ever since. Mayor Gimenez has dedicated his life to his community and the people of Miami-Dade County as a firefighter, an administrator and as an elected public servant.
Carlos has spent the last nine years fighting to lower taxes, balance the budget, protect the environment and more. Now, he’s building on this record as a candidate for Congress. In order to better serve South Florida, Carlos wants to hear directly from you. Tell him what matters to you and how you want to see him advocate for you on Day One in Congress!
## Check out the latest updates from the campaign:
Early voting ends TODAY.
❌ If you’re struggling to afford skyrocketing housing, gas, and groceries costs,
❌ If you believe your family deserves to live in a safe community,
❌ If you want a government that isn’t afraid to support our police,
Vote straight GOP today! #FL28
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) November 6, 2022
We’re ONE WEEK from Election Day.
Join me in the fight to save America from crushing costs of groceries and housing, surging crime in our communities, and the lack of opportunities for our families.
Vote early. Be heard. Together, we’ll stem the tide of Biden’s failure. #FL28 pic.twitter.com/FWlX2V6sH2
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) November 1, 2022
The Iranian-American community knows the importance of a constitution that respects freedom and human dignity.
America has always represented those values, but far too many are trying to take it all away.
In Congress, I’ll never stop putting freedom and rule of law FIRST. #FL28 https://t.co/jdF0ZUj3Wi
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) October 31, 2022
No more political games in Washington. It’s unfair to our children and grandchildren. They deserve better.
As your Congressman, I’ll never stop fighting for the American dream. #FL28 pic.twitter.com/SnNE0Mlkrq
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) October 24, 2022
After years of Washington’s failed policies tearing down our businesses, it’s time we put our economy back on a path to prosperity for all.
In Congress, I’ll never stop fighting for American job creators and innovators. I’m honored to receive the @USChamber endorsement. #FL28 https://t.co/GvIucSjCHL
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) October 20, 2022
I want to commend First Lady @CaseyDeSantis for raising funds for the Florida Disaster Fund.
Join me in donating to send our fellow Floridians a strong message of unity and solidarity as they recover from Hurricane Ian.
Visit https://t.co/Te3Nh9igtq or text DISASTER to 20222. pic.twitter.com/SrWi0wG6DN
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) October 17, 2022
We have to take this storm seriously, South Florida. Like every storm, #HurricaneIan can be unpredictable. Making sure you and your family are prepared can make all the difference.
Make sure you follow @FLSERT, @FEMA, and your local news outlets for the most updated information.
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) September 27, 2022
Happy #HispanicHeritageMonth! Latinos are an important part of America. They’re a big reason why #FL28 is the best place to live, work, and raise a family.
I’ll always fight to ensure Latinos have access to a quality education, an economy that works, and a chance to get ahead. pic.twitter.com/1zk4eIUVCz
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) September 15, 2022
Happy birthday to America’s Governor, @RonDeSantisFL! I’m grateful for your leadership in keeping Florida thriving, no matter what the mob throws at you.
Thanks for standing up for Florida, for backing the blue, and for honoring our servicemembers.
Let’s go win in November. 🇺🇸
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) September 14, 2022
Today we remember all we lost on #Sept11.
In the face of those barbaric acts of terrorism, we emerged a stronger, more united country. We prayed together, fought together, and made the grief of strangers our own.
That has always been our creed. United we stand, divided we fall. pic.twitter.com/tWR089Qj4d
— Carlos A. Gimenez (@CarlosGimenezFL) September 11, 2022
